BiblicalUsage: Hoham is a Canaanite king, the king of Hebron, and he stands in Joshua 10:3, where he joins the five kings who went up against Gibeon and were beaten by Joshua. The life behind the name is told on the Hoham, King of Hebron People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hoham matters because God names the kings who stood against His people as surely as He names His friends, and Hoham is one of them.
